name: Alma RFL
description: Automated workflow for processing Request for Leave (RFL) tickets in the Alma portal.

nodes.label: Receive RFL Ticket
nodes.description: Workflow starts when a new RFL ticket is assigned in the queue.

nodes.label: Open Alma Portal
nodes.description: Navigate to the Alma member portal and authenticate.

nodes.label: Lookup Member Record
nodes.description: Search for the member using ticket ID and verify account status.

nodes.label: Check RFL Eligibility
nodes.description: Determine whether the member is eligible for leave processing.

nodes.label: Process RFL Request
nodes.description: Submit the leave request and attach required documentation.

nodes.label: Notify Care Team
nodes.description: Send confirmation email to the care team with ticket summary.

nodes.label: Close Ticket
nodes.description: Mark the RFL ticket as resolved in the queue.

nodes.label: Reject Ineligible Request
nodes.description: Add rejection reason and route ticket back to manual review.
